subject: End-of-quarter check — priority for Redwood inference?
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@stellarapps.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-06-26T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Redwood follow-up: post-demo recap & next steps

Hey Alex,

Thanks again for taking the demo this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment:

- Demo highlights: low-latency text generation at scale, cost controls (batching/quantization), and private deployment options we discussed.
- Action items:
  1) I'll send a draft SOW + pricing for the 6-month pilot (attached: redwood-pricing-sheet.pdf).
  2) You to confirm target workloads (avg tokens/sec, peak concurrency) so we size dedicated capacity.
  3) Internal stakeholders: you mentioned bringing in Infra and Security for a quick review — timeline?

Question: Is end of Q2 still your target for a pilot decision? If so, we can prioritize a fast-track SOW and a dedicated onboarding slot.

Attaching the pricing sheet and a one-page pilot plan. Happy to jump on a 15-min call to close the gaps.

Thanks,
Aditya
Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0198

Attachment: redwood-pricing-sheet.pdf

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@stellarapps.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-06-29T14:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood follow-up: post-demo recap & next steps

Hey Aditya,

Thanks for the recap — this is helpful. We're interested. Two quick items:

1) I'll confirm workloads by Friday.
2) Leadership wants to see a scoped SOW + rough TCO. Can you send the SOW draft?

One note: finance is strapped in Q2, so budget approval may slide if we don't have sign-off by the end of this week.

I'll loop Infra/Security next week.

Cheers,
Alex
